about: The order the reference connector list names the shipped definitions in: the order they were added. Every other *.json here is one connector; one this list does not name follows these, alphabetically.
about_specs: The order the query planner's connector registry (enterprise_specs.BUILTIN_CONNECTORS) lists the shipped connectors in, from each definition's catalog. Every planned query row iterates it, so it is pinned. A connector it does not name follows in reference order.
about_capabilities: The order a corpus's connector dataset (connector_data.CAPABILITIES) lists each connector/entity whose catalog states record_verbs: the order they were added, so salesforce/case follows the file stores. A pair it does not name follows in reference order, then catalog order.
